title: HP–BH1: термодинамический баланс, нормировки и генеалогия

claims.statement: R^-4 d(C_A+f*DeltaC)/dt equals Q only for the declared conformal additive ansatz and H=Rdot/R
With cosmic H_a: Q=Gdot/R^4+4(H_a-H_R)*rho+H_a*Theta; R proportional to a and Theta=0 must be established
No sign of Q from the side of a state-space level curve; velocity is essential
G=G_star gives a family of energy level sets, not a unique kinetic vector field
Energy conservation alone does not establish reversible adiabatic evolution or a realizable conversion path
I=-ln Z, F=T I, C=-chi^2 I_prime/(2*pi^2), C_V=2*pi^2 C_prime
DeltaC(chi_c)=3*N^2/(16*pi^2)*[1+O(lambda)] at leading large N; no numeric remainder bound or arbitrary-chi extension
DeltaC at one chi does not determine its derivative or zero-exchange level sets
A common thermal term changes derivatives; a constant Casimir k/R shifts absolute C but not C_prime
Compensation through f*DeltaC_prime survives without C_A_prime; dropping the latter requires a uniform ratio bound
DeltaC/DeltaC_prime is a local inverse logarithmic derivative, not an established transition width
Free large-N U(N) confined Z is available; SU(N) has the common adjoint-character correction and vacuum convention must be recorded
Free Hagedorn pole cannot directly supply interacting chi_c heat capacity; lambda^-2/lambda^-4 estimates need consistent interacting soft-mode validity
Q0 is a chosen baseline derivative unless an actual subsystem and interaction are separately defined
Algebraic rewriting is not proof of gauge symmetry
Probability, volume fraction and collective coordinate can share a mean yet differ in internal fluctuations, interfaces and kinetic energy
Reduced-potential adapter and BH0 verifier do not calculate complete Z_A/Z_B or absolute C_A; latent heat is a literature input in the bridge
Same G does not fix a continuation profile or a common physical generator across model variants
Free-branch normalization and convergence contract is a concrete possible next step; no RUN_REQUEST or BH1 activation

review_mode: post-discussion analytic checking; not a preregistered confirmatory HP experiment
remaining_inputs: Full branch thermodynamics at a declared accuracy and normalization
Physical meaning of f and full energy accounting
existing_scientific_status_policy: Preserve all existing R/C/L/U entries and historic FAIL/REVIEW evidence
